$comment: Single source of truth for every generated core plugin + marketplace manifest. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/generate-plugin-manifests.mjs`. Never hand-edit a generated manifest — scripts/validate-plugin.mjs regenerates and fails CI on drift. Not read by any client; both Agent Plugins and Claude Code ignore unknown root files.
name: e2a

descriptions.$comment: Three variants ship today. `manifest` omits HITL; both marketplace variants mention it. See docs/design/2026-08-09-agent-plugins-conformance.md — unifying them is a copy decision, deliberately not made by this migration. The MCP tool count must match mcp/tool-names.v1.json; the validator checks numeric claims.
descriptions.manifest: Open-source email API for applications and AI agents — transactional sending from any product, per-agent two-way inboxes, structured SPF/DKIM/DMARC evidence, and a queryable event log. 79 MCP tools over hosted streamable HTTP with OAuth.
